victory.name: Mature planet
victory.text: Every stage of life, from bacteria to large mammals, is alive at once and holds for 5 years.

won.title: Congratulations, Apprentice!
won.body:
You made the planet bloom. [b]{goal}[/b] was reached on [b]{date}[/b]: {alive} of {total} stages of life are alive. Stars: {stars}.

You bought {perks} perks and caught {bubbles} bubbles. The Creator is silent, and humanity has some thinking to do.

The planet is yours to keep growing.

timeup.title: Time is up
timeup.body:
The {years} years are over. {alive} of {total} stages of life live on the planet.

The Creator is not convinced yet. You bought {perks} perks and caught {bubbles} bubbles; the planet is still yours to keep growing.

stars.name: Light hand
stars.text: {min_interventions} to {max_interventions} actions, with mirrors and dust only lightly

ambitions.name: Breath of the planet
ambitions.text: oxygen above 10.9 % of atmosphere before year 13

ambitions.name: Big game
ambitions.text: large mammals with a population above 10

ambitions.name: Survive the winter
ambitions.text: an ice age passed with no extinction while at least 4 stages of life lived

ambitions.name: After the fire
ambitions.text: a fire season passed and trees have a population of at least 10

ambitions.name: Gardener
ambitions.text: bring back a species that died out by seeding it

ambitions.name: Hands off
ambitions.text: a mature planet without a single action
